message.reasoning: The user says: "start Docker on window using docker start." They want to start Docker on Windows using docker start. But docker start is used to start containers, not the Docker daemon. To start Docker service, you need to start Docker Desktop or the Docker Engine service. On Windows, you can use `net start com.docker.service` or `Start-Service -Name com.docker.service` in PowerShell. Or use Docker Desktop UI. The user might want to run a command via the tool. We have a function to execute Windows command. So we can call `cmd_controller_execute` with command to start Docker service. Let's propose `net start com.docker.service`. Or `Start-Service -Name com.docker.service`. The function expects a string. We'll use `net start com.docker.service`. That will start the Docker service. Alternatively, if Docker Desktop is installed, you can start it via `& "C:\Program Files\Docker\Docker\Docker Desktop.exe"`. But the simplest is `net start com.docker.service`.
